cycle1: Add lagged 200-session simple-moving-average regime filter to unchanged positive 7/21 momentum; exit immediately when either baseline or regime condition fails. Hypothesis: avoid prolonged bear markets, at cost of delayed recovery participation.
cycle2: Evaluate unchanged positive 7/21 momentum only at the first trading session of each ISO week; otherwise retain position, including delayed exits. Hypothesis: less signal churn offsets slower responses. This is decision cadence, not hysteresis or volatility sizing.
cycle3: Unchanged baseline exit; while flat, require baseline positivity AND negative lagged two-session close return to enter. Hypothesis: buy pullbacks within momentum rather than chase; no added holding-period rule.
baseline: Preserved baseline r7>0 AND r21>0, full long else cash, daily decisions; exact preserved execution arithmetic imported without edits. Preserved submission was only a cash hold; historical extension is not an official historical submission.
controls: Identical initial cash, dates, fill policy and terminal liquidation for baseline, candidate and buy-and-hold. 100000 per instrument/fold. Public basket aggregate is five independent 100000 sleeves with no cross-asset rebalance.
execution: Signals use completed session t-1; stockdata fills at session t close, then marked at same close. Prior AAPL fills at t open, marks at t close. Fractional shares, cash funded long-only, no leverage. Every fill has adverse 5bps slippage and 10bps fee on slipped notional. Liquidate at final close. Next-close target-weight fractional fills assume fill-price sizing, unlike advance fixed-quantity official orders. AAPL next-open is explicitly not official next-close. No official reruns.
evaluation: Fixed parameters; 2007 warmup excluded, 2008-01-01 through 2016-03-01 continuous runs plus separately cash-reset nonoverlapping annual walk-forward evaluation blocks with preceding price warmup. No fitting. 2016 public block partial. Prior AAPL 2016-01-04 through 2017-02-16 is an explicitly already-viewed replication/control sample. Annual reset blocks are not additive with continuous results.
dependence: The five public series share dates and market factors. AAPL overlaps prior viewed data in 2015-2016; none is claimed unseen. Public source availability and chosen fixed hypotheses introduce selection effects. All three hypotheses share samples and controls; neither folds nor cycles are independent trials.
limitations: Historical adjusted-like price conventions not verified as point-in-time; retrospective corporate action effects, no corporate action cash ledger, no cash interest/taxes/market impact or intraday risk. GSPC is a noninvestable index proxy; stockdata original vendor/adjustments unverified. Small and correlated historical sample, no prospective evidence. No live deployment or competition win claim.
